rows.grounds: compound denoting mechanisms or realms of birth
past passive participle describing afflicted beings

items.question: In what vast array of birth-mechanisms are beings subjected to torment?
premises: The number specified is eighty-four thousand.
These thousands are womb-diagrams or birth-mechanisms.
Beings within them are described as tormented.
items.inference: Beings suffer torment across eighty-four thousand different womb-diagrams or mechanisms of birth.
uncertainties: The subject experiencing torment is implied from context rather than explicitly stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
